subject.title: fix(plugins): bound before_tool_call hook with a default timeout

question: Should existing `before_tool_call` plugin handlers be subject to a fixed 15-second fail-closed timeout, even when a handler previously completed successfully after a longer wait?
rationale: The code uses the existing timeout mechanism and correctly preserves fail-closed handling, but selecting a new default changes the observable behavior of third-party plugin hooks and requires owner intent.

options.title: Adopt the 15-second default
options.body: Treat gating hooks as fast policy checks and merge the bounded fail-closed timeout with the included regression test.

options.title: Preserve current waiting behavior
options.body: Do not add this default until a supported compatibility or opt-in design is selected for long-running existing handlers.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 15-second default
recommendation.body: Treat gating hooks as fast policy checks and merge the bounded fail-closed timeout with the included regression test.

likelyOwner.person: Plugin-hook area owner (not identified from the available review evidence)
likelyOwner.reason: This owner needs to decide the external plugin runtime contract rather than merely approve a mechanical timeout-table edit.
